Status marker — read-only. 20px tall, sharp corners, sentence case (or caps if `mono`).

```jsx
<Badge tone="success" dot>Confirmed</Badge>
<Badge tone="danger" variant="solid">Sold out</Badge>
<Badge tone="accent" mono>Q4</Badge>
```

`subtle` is the default and correct 90% of the time; `solid` only when the badge must win against imagery. Use `dot` for live/status semantics.
